entry.name: jit.cellblock
entry.digest: Edit rows and columns of data
entry.description: Provides storage, viewing and editing of two-dimensional data. The format is similar to the "grid" display tools found in many other development environments. The current cell location, format, display and contents within jit.cellblock can be set with the mouse or by using Max messages.

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: automouse
attributes.digest: Automatic scrolling and selection with the mouse
attributes.description: Enables/disables scrolling or selecting cells by clicking and dragging with the mouse. The default is 1 (enabled).

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: bblend
attributes.description: Specifies the percentage of background blending for theobject's display.In cases where there are both column and row background color overrides, this message will allow you to "blend" the colors. Column colors have a higher priority than row colors; if you have a row and column color that affect a cell, only the column color will normally be displayed. Themessage allows you to make the column color transparant using a percentage value, thereby allowing the row color to be displayed. This message applies the color transparency to all column colors without discrimination.

attributes.description: Sets the default background color of theobject in RGBA format.

attributes.description: Toggles drawing a border edge around the.

attributes.name: colhead
attributes.description: Toggles the behavior of the first column. If the header option is selected, the first column will change color to the rgba setting, and will not be directly editable in selmode 5.

attributes.name: cols
attributes.description: Sets the number of columns that are visible within the. If the number of columns is greater than can be displayed, scrollbars will be shown.

attributes.name: colwidth
attributes.description: Sets the default column width of the individual cells. Changing these settings may change whether the scrollbars are displayed.

attributes.name: datadirty
attributes.description: Enables or disables the patcher-dirty flag. The default is 0 (disabled). When enabled, theobject will dirty the patch whenever its cell data changes.

attributes.name: fblend
attributes.description: Specifies the percentage of foreground blending for theobject's display.In cases where there are both column and row foreground color overrides, this message will allow you to "blend" the colors. Column colors have a higher priority than row colors; if you have a row and column color that affect a cell, only the column color will normally be displayed. Themessage allows you to make the column color transparent using a percentage value, thereby allowing the row color to be displayed. This message applies the color transparency to all column colors without discrimination.

attributes.name: just
attributes.description: Sets the default text justification of all cells - left (0), center (1) or right (2).

attributes.name: neverdirty
attributes.description: Whenis enabled, changes to column, row, or cell properties do not dirty the patcher.

attributes.name: outmode
attributes.description: Sets the output mode of the cellblock. The output mode settings are:0. separate values: Each cell is sent separately, and each data item within the cell is sent as a separate value.1. as one list: If more than one cell is selected, all cell contents are formatted into a single list and output as a single cell output.2. as one symbol: If more than one cell is selected, or if a cell has more than one value (e.g. a list), all values are combined into a single, space-separated symbol for output.

attributes.description: Sets the default floating point precision for all cells. This does not alter the actual contents of the cell - it only changes the displayed precision of those contents.

attributes.name: rowhead
attributes.description: Toggles the behavior of the first row. If the header option is selected, the first row will change color to the rgba setting, and will not be directly editable in selmode 5.

attributes.name: rowheight
attributes.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the default row height of the individual cells. Changing these settings may change whether the scrollbars are displayed.

attributes.name: rows
attributes.description: Sets the number of columns and rows that are visible within the. If the number of rows is greater than can be displayed, scrollbars will be shown.

attributes.name: savemode
attributes.description: Toggles the ability save theobject's cell contents as part of the main patcher. The default behavior is 0 (save the data as a separate file).

attributes.name: sccolor
attributes.description: Sets the default text background color of the scroller in RGBA format.

attributes.name: selmode
attributes.description: Sets the selection mode of the cellblock. The selection mode settings are:0. no selection1. select a single cell2. select an entire column3. select an entire row4. select a single cell unless a column or row header is selected, in which case the entire column or row is selected.5. in-place editing. A single cell is selected and values can be typed directly into the cell.

attributes.name: selsync
attributes.description: Toggles synchronizing selection with anotherobject whose third outlet is connected to the right-most inlet of theobject.

attributes.name: sgcolor
attributes.description: Sets the default text color of the scroller gutter in RGBA format.

messages.name: append
messages.description: The word, followed by a data element or a list of elements, will add the specified valid Max data to the contents of the currently selected cell.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Sends the contents out the object's left outlet, and sends a message through the third outlet in the form set value-list.

messages.name: cell
messages.digest: Control the appearance of a cell
messages.description: Themessage allows you to control the appearance of a single cell within the cellblock. Using themessage will override changes for both row and col message.

messages.name: clear
messages.digest: The clear message removes data from the cellblock.
messages.description: Themessage removes data from the cellblock. The message clears the contents of the specified cell.will clear the entire contents of the cellblock. The messagewill clear the contents of the currently selected cell(s). Themessage with no arguments is equivalent to the message.

messages.name: col
messages.digest: Control the appearance of a column
messages.description: The col message allows you to control the appearance of a single column within the cellblock. Using the col message to override color settings will override any color changes made with the row message. Using the cell message will, however, override color changes for both col and row messages.

messages.name: deref
messages.description: Disconnects aobject from any attachedobjects.

messages.name: dump
messages.description: Sends a listing of the contents of all non-empty cells out the object's left outlet, one line per cell. Each output line takes the form col-number row-number cell-contents.

messages.name: jit_deref
messages.description: The messagewill dereference the currently referencedobject.

messages.name: jit_matrix
messages.description: The messagewill cause theobject's display/edit to directly reference the receivedrather than maintaining its own data structure.

messages.name: list
messages.description: Selects a cell within the cellblock. The message list col-number row-number is equivalent to the message select col-number row-number.

messages.name: plane
messages.digest: Select a jit.matrix plane to display
messages.description: The wordfollowed by an integer that specifies a numbered plane in aobject, will display that plane. The special messagewill display all four planes of an RGBAobject simultaneously.

messages.name: prepend
messages.digest: Prepend data to a cell's contents
messages.description: Adds the specified valid Max data to the beginning of the currently selected cell contents.

messages.name: read
messages.digest: Read cellblock contents from a file
messages.description: Opens and reads the contents of a cellblock file from disk if a filename is specified. No attempts are made to verify the contents. If no filename is specified, a file dialog box will be displayed to allow selection of a saved cellblock file.

messages.name: refer
messages.digest: Create a reference to a coll object
messages.description: The word, followed by the name of a, object, displays the contents of the namedobject's internal list. Changes to the data in thewill change the contents of the attachedobject.

messages.name: refresh
messages.description: Causes theobject to be redrawn.

messages.name: row
messages.digest: Control the appearance of a row
messages.description: The row message allows you to control the appearance of a single row within the cellblock.

messages.name: rowblend
messages.description: The word, followed by two numbers in the range 0-100 specifying foreground and background blend percentages. blends the foreground and background colors for the cellblock object.

messages.name: select
messages.description: The select message, followed by a column number and row number, will select the requested cell using the current selmode. The leftmost outlet ofoutputs a message in the format of. The third outlet outputs a message in the format of, which can be connected to anotherfor synchronization between two cellblocks.

messages.name: send
messages.digest: Send data to a receive object
messages.description: The word, followed by the name of aobject, will transmit cellblock values without using connected patch cords; it is the equivalent of sending the output through aobject.send receive-object col-number row-number will send the data in the specified cell to the specified received object. send receive-object all sends all non-empty cell contents to the specified receive object as a series of lists in the form cell-data-type value.

messages.name: set
messages.description: Replaces a cell's data with the data specified. Two forms are supported:set current value replaces the currently selected cell's contents.set col-number row-number values replaces the specified cell's contents.

messages.name: setwithoutdirty
messages.description: The wordfollowed by any message to, executes that message without dirtying the patcher. Example:sets the text justification of column 0 without dirtying the patcher, which would normally occur when sending this message. You can also disable patcher dirtying permanently by enabling theattribute. Ironically, doing so will itself dirty the patcher.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: Displays signal input based on theattribute setting.

messages.name: sync
messages.description: Receives input in theobject's right inlet from anotherobject, so that two cellblocks can maintain location and selection synchronization. Synchronization allows for multipleobjects to react as if connected. One use of synchronization is used to force external cellblock objects to act as header rows and columns for a main. For more information on setting synchronization, see themessage.

messages.name: text
messages.description: Replaces the value of the currently selected cell with the incoming text values. This is provided as a convenient way of receiving the output of aobject.

messages.name: write
messages.digest: Write all data to a disk file
messages.description: Opens a file and writes the contents of a cellblock file to disk. If a filename is specified, that file is created and written. If no filename is specified, a file dialog box will be displayed to allow selection of a pathname and file.

messages.name: writeagain
messages.description: If a file has been written, themessage will allow it to be rewritten without further user interaction.
